key.ivautopilot.cycle_mode: Autopilot: Off / Pitch hold / Altitude hold
msg.ivautopilot.not_pilot: Sit in an aircraft's pilot seat to use the autopilot.
msg.ivautopilot.runway_unnamed: Rename this Runway Marker in an anvil (e.g. "KJFK 09"), then place one at each end of the runway.
msg.ivautopilot.runway_half: Runway %s: 1 of 2 markers placed. Place the other one at the far end of the runway.
msg.ivautopilot.no_runway: No complete runway named %s here. See /autopilot runways.
msg.ivautopilot.no_runways: No runways yet. Place two Runway Markers with the same name, one at each end.
msg.ivautopilot.nav_started: Autopilot: flying to %s. It will line up, land and stop on the runway. Touch the flight controls in the flare or rollout to take over.
msg.ivautopilot.not_lined_up: To take off automatically, line up on a runway first (on the centerline, in the first half, facing down it) - or park near the taxiway network so the plane can taxi out to a runway with a linked entrance.
msg.ivautopilot.same_runway: You're already on that runway. Pick a different destination.
msg.ivautopilot.takeoff_cancelled: Autopilot: you touched the controls, takeoff handed over to you.
msg.ivautopilot.takeoff_aborted: Autopilot: TAKEOFF ABORTED, not fast enough with the runway left. Braking.
msg.ivautopilot.engines_failed: Autopilot: engines wouldn't start (fuel? battery?). Takeoff cancelled.
msg.ivautopilot.takeoff_started: Autopilot: taking off, then flying to %s and landing there. Touch the flight controls to take over.
msg.ivautopilot.go_around: Autopilot: GO AROUND (%s). Climbing out to try again.
msg.ivautopilot.landing_gave_up: Autopilot: %s go-arounds, giving up. Holding at the approach; land by hand or /autopilot fly again.
msg.ivautopilot.landing_cancelled: Autopilot: you touched the controls, landing handed over to you.
msg.ivautopilot.landed: Autopilot: landed at %s. Parking brake set, autopilot off.
msg.ivautopilot.airport_zone: %s: %s blocks. Inside it, departing planes keep their wings level until they leave it; arrivals and landings aren't affected. /genwaypoints airport lays out its taxiways.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_placed: Taxi waypoint placed. Link it with the Taxiway Wand.
msg.ivautopilot.gate_placed: Gate "%s" placed. Link it to the taxiways with the Taxiway Wand.
msg.ivautopilot.wand_selected: Waypoint selected. Click another waypoint to link (or unlink), or a Runway Marker to make this its entrance.
msg.ivautopilot.wand_linked: Linked (%s blocks). Click the next waypoint to keep going.
msg.ivautopilot.wand_waypoint_first: Click a Taxi Waypoint first, then the Runway Marker.
msg.ivautopilot.wand_runway_linked: Waypoint is now this runway end's entrance/exit.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_on_ground_only: Taxiing is only possible on the ground.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_no_route: No taxi route to %s: is the plane on a runway or within 80 blocks of a taxi waypoint, and do the waypoints connect to it (a runway needs a waypoint linked to it or next to it)?
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_parked: Autopilot: parked at %s. Parking brake set.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_lined_up: Autopilot: lined up on runway %s. /autopilot fly <runway> to take off.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_lined_up_takeoff: Autopilot: lined up on runway %s, taking off.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_cancelled: Autopilot: you touched the controls, taxi handed over to you.
msg.ivautopilot.holding_traffic: Autopilot: runway %s in use, holding at the approach until it's our turn.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_rerouted: Autopilot: taxi route blocked, taking another way.
msg.ivautopilot.landed_taxi: Autopilot: landed on %s, taxiing to gate %s.
msg.ivautopilot.delay_set: Autopilot: holding for %s s, then starting.
msg.ivautopilot.delay_ground_only: Autopilot: the delay only applies on the ground; starting now.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_placed_auto: Taxi waypoint placed, %s link(s) made automatically. Fix any with the Taxiway Wand.
msg.ivautopilot.terminal_placed: Terminal gate "%s" placed and linked to the nearest taxi waypoint.
msg.ivautopilot.terminal_placed_unlinked: Terminal gate "%s" placed. No taxi waypoint in reach: link it with the Taxiway Wand.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_unknown_block: Unknown block "%s". Give a comma-separated list, e.g. gray_concrete,yellow_concrete
msg.ivautopilot.gen_done: Taxi network generated: %s waypoints placed (%s existing reused), %s links, %s runway entrances, %s terminal gates hooked up.
msg.ivautopilot.taxi_no_gate: No terminal gate or runway called "%s". (Tab lists them.)
msg.ivautopilot.gen_started: Generating the taxi network within %s blocks... (progress bar at the top; /genwaypoints cancel stops it)
msg.ivautopilot.gen_started_airport: Generating the taxi network for airport %s (%s x %s)... (progress bar at the top; /genwaypoints cancel stops it)
msg.ivautopilot.gen_busy: Already generating a taxi network. Wait for it, or /genwaypoints cancel.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_no_airport: You're not inside an airport. Place two Airport Markers at opposite corners and stand between them, or give a radius instead.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_too_big: That airport (%s x %s) is over the limit of %s blocks a side. Split it into smaller airports, or use a radius.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_bar_layout: Taxi network: working out the taxiways
msg.ivautopilot.gen_connected: The network is all connected (%2$s joins added between pieces, %3$s waypoints couldn't be placed).
msg.ivautopilot.gen_pieces: Still %s separate pieces after adding %s joins (%s waypoints couldn't be placed). Link the gaps with the Taxiway Wand, or check the map.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_no_runways: No runways in this area: place two Runway Markers with the same name at each runway's ends BEFORE generating, or the runways are treated as taxiway and get no entrances.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_map: Map of what was found saved as %s in the game folder (grey = taxiway used, dark red = obstacles, orange = raised surfaces, yellow/red = network, cyan = joins, magenta = couldn't place).
msg.ivautopilot.gen_relevel: Most of the taxiway surface is at y=%2$s, not y=%1$s: reading the area again at that level.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_bar_rereading: Taxi network: reading the ground again at the right level (%s%%)
msg.ivautopilot.gen_missing: Not in your block list (so not used as taxiway): %s. If that's taxiway paving, add it, or leave the list out to use all paving.
msg.ivautopilot.gen_entrances: Made %s taxiway dead ends next to runways into runway entrances.
